# Architecture

Imports run one way. A layer may use anything below it and nothing above
it. Every layer may use the foundation: `shearstud`, `shearstud.errors`, `shearstud.units`.

`check_layers` enforces the table below, and this page is generated from
the same table, so the two cannot drift apart.

## Layers

| Layer       | Modules | Lines | What it is for                                                    |
| ----------- | ------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| (top level) | 3       | 186   | units, the error tree, and nothing that knows about a bridge      |
| geometry    | 8       | 1026  | plates, sections, composite stages and section loss               |
| loads       | 9       | 1283  | vehicles, influence lines, distribution and the dynamic allowance |
| signals     | 6       | 958   | strain records, conditioning, defects, rainflow and spectra       |
| fatigue     | 5       | 624   | detail categories, Miner damage, remaining life and evaluation    |
| structure   | 7       | 812   | the inventory: identity, spans, girders, details and gauges       |
| rating      | 7       | 1014  | capacity, load factors, the rating equation, posting and permits  |
| store       | 12      | 1852  | the book of record, its migrations and its repositories           |
| analysis    | 4       | 609   | dead load, and the runs that use everything below at once         |
| cli         | 5       | 797   | the command line, which is how anyone outside the package uses it |
| tools       | 17      | 2048  | the repository's own checks and generated documents               |
